component.name: AniRust
component.summary: Desktop client for Anixart with a player of its own
Клиент Anixart для компьютера со своим плеером

description.p: AniRust is an unofficial desktop client for Anixart. It browses and searches the catalogue, plays episodes in an mpv-based player with hardware decoding, subtitles, Anime4K upscaling and frame interpolation, and keeps lists, history and progress in step with an Anixart account.
It also reads the feed and channels, comments, collections and notifications, and writes posts — the whole of the official client, on a computer.
AniRust is not affiliated with the developers of Anixart.
